name: Columns
description: Organise content visually with a column-based layout.

allowStacking.description: Option to explicitly specify whether adapt the layout by stacking columns when the viewport or container is narrow. Defaults to true behaviour but does not put the attribute in the HTML unless explicitly set. You generally do not want to set this if your theme will handle it on a case-by-case basis with custom CSS.

ariaAttrs.description: Allow for aria-* attributes to be passed down to the wrapper explicitly

backgroundColors.description: Key -> value pairs of background placement and colour keywords

context.description: The kebab-case or BEM element chain name of the parent component or variant (if contextually relevant).

dataAttrs.description: Allow for data-* attributes to be passed down to the container explicitly; useful for cases that aren't worth creating a trait or shared property for (e.g., Columns uses this for data-count)

isNested.description: Whether this component is nested inside another element; used for simplifying layout and HTML structure handling

shortName.description: The name of the component without any namespacing, prefixes, etc. Used for BEM block/element naming. Derived from the Blade filename if not explicitly set.

tagName.description: The HTML tag to use for this component

testId.description: Optionally add a data-testid attribute for automated tests

withContainer.description: Whether to wrap the inner components in a Container. Defaults to true if the component is not nested. Will be ignored if the component is already a Container or is nested.
